spans.s: मोघ (I) a. (f. घा) 1. Aimless, useless, vain, मोघवृत्ति कलभस्य चेष्टितम् R.xi.39, xiv.65; 2. unsuccessful, याच्ञा मोघा वरमधिगुणे माधमे लब्धकामा Megh.i.6; 3. left, abandoned; 4. idle.
मोघ (II) m. A fence, a hedge.(मोघम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘to no purpose, in vain.’)

मोघोलि m. a fence, a hedge.
